c1.source: All 21 budget-qualified exact stage6b jobs; reuse original baseline LOS, no new search
c1.definition: Keep original reference vertices strictly before max(0,L-2); append the interpolated anchor then the true goal. Remove duplicate vertices. Independently certify every resulting chord at the frozen full effective radius. Reject rather than fall back or select a per-path adapter.
c1.causal_scope: Whole reference-adapter intervention; terminal geometry, tangent and timing may all change. No claim of isolated switching causality.
c1.pipeline_planning_charge: Original stage6b independent_certificate_finish_s; new replay input/read/adapter/LOS included in the20s adapter clock

c2.gate: C0 and analytical/safety/interface C1 checks pass, zero safety false positives, and reference-domain interpretation reviewed. Otherwise mark C2 not run.
c2.pilot: straight, native seed1, all4 conditions; reused in72
c2.expansion_gate: No process/setup/serialization errors or model/safety mismatch; each pilot peak native RSS<=1GiB, record<=5MiB, and available physical RAM>=4GiB. Budget failures remain failures and do not justify choosing another seed. If a resource gate fails stop and record pending review.
c2.metric: Same compound weighted sum: R3 distance in metres plus SO2 and pitch distances in radians, weights1. Radius is a mixed metric value, not a physical metre.
c2.sampling: Unchanged official SST/RRT uniform controls and1-50 steps; RRT valid-prefix and SST whole-duration semantics retained
c2.objective: Official ControlDurationObjective; first mode cost threshold +infinity; anytime threshold0 and one continuous official solve call
c2.instrumentation: Read-only SST protected incumbent accessor used only by official improvement callback; no solve, selection, pruning or propagation override. Save first and final controls once, deduplicate if identical. Native certify improvement paths; independently replay first and final returned paths and charge all work to10s.
c2.timing: Separate first native certificate event, candidate return, and actual independent first/best certificate finish; never backdate independent certificate availability
c2.c2_los: Secondary only: final budget-qualified model path uses unchanged stage6b dense+bridge contract, with independent reference certification and frozen LOS. The C1 adapter is a diagnostic, not selected based on success and not silently substituted into C2.
c2.execution: Serial CPU; fresh process per job; no F or holdout maps

stop: No H1 implementation, model/controller changes, new holdout maps,324-trial matrix, file hashes or historical modifications. Stop on correctness/safety disagreement. Retain approximate, late, rejected and failed conditions.
